title: Image generation got better guardrails
summary:
Image generation got firmer limits and fewer unnecessary waits, while the model catalog and community projects list got some attention too.

Flux Kontext safety checks now return a timeout error after 30 seconds rather than leaving requests waiting indefinitely. After several cache-limit changes, the generated-image cache ended the week capped at 1,000 entries with oldest-entry eviction. Progress bars also stopped filling non-TTY logs.

Telemetry moved into the background, and cached-image requests stopped making a provider lookup for every hit. The anonymous queue-limit change was reverted, leaving anonymous and registered requests with up to five slots each.

Enter’s model-list proxy was corrected to request the upstream model-list endpoint. Unused text services, orphaned IDs, and the Mistral Nemo aliases were removed; image provider lookups also moved to the shared registry.

Green Hope AI joined the creative projects list with editable generated thumbnails. Jay-1409 also contributed a standalone Next.js email utility with reusable templates; it is separate from Pollinations services.
